06 / Architecture · Luxury · Fashion

Learning by showing up.

From Lakmé Fashion Week and Bulgari to Vogue Forces of Fashion and architectural design shows, I found myself exploring a world I had always been curious about. I wasn't there just for the glamour. I wanted to see how luxury brands think, how fashion comes together, and how design, storytelling, and experiences create something memorable. Every event gave me a different perspective on creativity, craftsmanship, and the luxury industry. Sometimes, the best way to learn about an industry is simply to step inside it.
